stemMd:
A researcher proposes that a community garden's shared tool shed does more than reduce equipment costs: it also creates opportunities for neighbors who would otherwise rarely meet to exchange advice.

Which finding would most directly support the researcher's proposal?

options.label: B
options.textMd: The shed contains several sizes of shovel.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The shed was built from inexpensive timber.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Gardeners report meeting unfamiliar neighbors while borrowing tools and later consulting those neighbors about planting.

explanationMd: The claim concerns new social connections and advice exchange. Reports that tool borrowing initiates precisely those interactions directly support the proposed function beyond cost savings.

distractorRationale.b: Tool variety supports practical use but not social exchange.
distractorRationale.c: Construction cost does not establish new interactions.
distractorRationale.a: Glove ownership does not show whether the shed creates relationships.
